third_stomach.name: Third Stomach
third_stomach.description: Expands stomach capacity to 3 slots! Fusions always mix the 2 newest flavors.

wide_mouth.name: Wide Mouth
wide_mouth.description: Increases tongue snatch reach by +30% for catching faraway bugs and pests.

slow_digest.name: Slow Digestion
slow_digest.description: Extends digest timer by +6 seconds, giving you more time to hold active fusions.

sticky_tongue.name: Sticky Tongue
sticky_tongue.description: Your tongue becomes super adhesive, reeling in up to 2 targets in a single whip!

echo_spit.name: Echo Spit
echo_spit.description: Every spit fires a second duplicate projectile with 60% damage.

pond_blessing.name: Pond Blessing
pond_blessing.description: The sacred waters heal. Regain 1 lost tadpole every 3 waves.

heavy_landing.name: Heavy Landing
heavy_landing.description: Meteor Slam energy charges 50% faster from kills and snatches.

hot_streak.name: Hot Streak
hot_streak.description: Your Flavor Streak multiplier does not reset on your first missed shot.

lucky_fly.name: Lucky Dragonfly
lucky_fly.description: Golden Wildcard Flies spawn 3x more frequently over the lilypads.

thick_skin.name: Thick Skin
thick_skin.description: Permanently grants +1 maximum Heart and fully restores all health.

burp_boom.name: Burp Boom
burp_boom.description: Overeating burps detonate in a shockwave that deals 2.0 damage to nearby pests.
